title: vla.cpp: A Unified Inference Runtime for Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.08094v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Deploying vision--language--action (VLA) models on robots requires adapting model-specific inference pipelines to heterogeneous processors and limited onboard memory. We present vla.cpp, a unified C++ inference runtime for eleven VLA models, with no PyTorch dependency for model execution. The runtime shares model loading, tensor execution, and serving while retaining architecture-specific attention, conditioning, and action heads. Iterative policies reuse observation-dependent computation across solver steps, while regression policies predict actions directly. We evaluate task success on LIBERO-Object and profile supported configurations on NVIDIA, Apple, and Intel hardware. BitVLA completes 200/200 LIBERO-Object episodes on an 8,GB Jetson Orin Nano. A ternary tensor-core kernel accelerates its client inference by $4.0$--$4.6\times$ over the CUDA-core baseline on RTX 3060 and AGX Orin. A SmolVLA case study links positional-inde

translated_title: vla.cpp：面向视觉-语言-动作模型的统一推理运行时
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.08094v2 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：在机器人上部署视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，需要将特定于模型的推理流水线适配到异构处理器和有限的机载内存上。我们提出了vla.cpp，这是一个支持十一种VLA模型的统一C++推理运行时，其模型执行不依赖PyTorch。该运行时共享模型加载、张量执行和服务功能，同时保留特定于架构的注意力机制、条件机制和动作头。迭代式策略在求解器各步骤间复用依赖观测的计算，而回归式策略则直接预测动作。我们在LIBERO-Object上评估任务成功率，并在NVIDIA、Apple和Intel硬件上对支持的配置进行性能分析。BitVLA在8GB Jetson Orin Nano上完成了200/200个LIBERO-Object回合。一个三值张量核心内核使其客户端推理在RTX 3060和AGX Orin上相比CUDA核心基线加速4.0–4.6倍。一个SmolVLA案例研究将位置索引（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: vla.cpp是一个不依赖PyTorch的统一C++推理运行时，支持十一种视觉-语言-动作模型在NVIDIA、Apple和Intel等异构硬件上高效部署，并借助三值张量核心内核加速，使BitVLA能在8GB Jetson Orin Nano上完成全部LIBERO-Object任务。
en_tdlr: vla.cpp is a unified PyTorch-free C++ inference runtime supporting eleven vision-language-action models across NVIDIA, Apple, and Intel hardware, whose ternary tensor-core kernel enables BitVLA to complete all 200 LIBERO-Object episodes on an 8GB Jetson Orin Nano with 4.0–4.6× speedup.
